costs: RD-002 crypto model: Binance USDT-M taker 5 bps/side + 3 bps/side spread+slippage = 16 bps round trip (rd2.costs2.costs_for). Sensitivity: any gate meeting the improvement rule is re-run at 2x costs and reported (sensitivity, not an additional trial).
data: Identical to RD-002: Binance Vision USDT-M futures monthly klines via the harness data_feed cache contract (per-zip SHA-256, canonical CSV SHA-256, gap audit), cache dir /home/hatch/workspace/str-rd2/cache2; 4h and 1d derived from 1h by the harness resample rule (UTC-aligned, complete buckets only). No new data, no substitutions.
declared_at: 2026-11-15 (IST), frozen before the first gated execution; the ungated runs in this study are replications of RD-002 cells (sanity anchors), not trials

components.vol_percentile: rank of atr_pct[i] within the trailing 252 atr_pct values ending at i (fraction of window values strictly below atr_pct[i]); requires a full 252-value window

detector.computed_per_symbol_at_strategy_timefram: All series causal: the state for a signal produced on the close of bar i uses bars <= i only (entries fill at the open of bar i+1, the harness MODULE convention).
detector.parameters_note: All parameters (ADX 14, threshold 20; EMA 50/200; ATR 14; 252-value percentile window; 2/3 tercile) are literature-standard round numbers fixed here, before execution. No parameter is tuned in this study; any other parameterisation would be a new pre-declared family.

states.COUNTER_TREND: entry side LONG and ema50[i] < ema200[i], or entry side SHORT and ema50[i] > ema200[i]
states.UNKNOWN: any required component is NaN at bar i (insufficient warm-up). UNKNOWN is NOT hostile: the entry is kept. UNKNOWN counts are reported per cell.

folds: W1..W5 exactly as the harness walkforward.FOLDS (OOS starts 2024-07-01 .. 2026-11-01); trades attributed to folds by ENTRY time; headline metrics pooled over OOS folds only, computed by rd2.stats2.fold_report / simulator.trade_metrics — the same code that produced the RD-002 rows.

gates.gate_both: drop the entry if RANGING or VOL_HIGH at its signal bar
gates.gate_counter: drop the entry if COUNTER_TREND at its signal bar
gates.gate_range: drop the entry if RANGING at its signal bar
gates.gate_vol: drop the entry if VOL_HIGH at its signal bar

improvement_rule: A gate IMPROVES an entrant iff ALL of: (1) gated pooled OOS expectancy_net > ungated; (2) gated profit_factor_net >= ungated; (3) gated max_drawdown_net >= ungated (drawdown no deeper); (4) gated OOS trades >= 50% of ungated OOS trades. Otherwise the verdict is DOES NOT IMPROVE. All 8 cells are reported with full gated-vs-ungated numbers (trades, expectancy, PF, max DD, total return, per-fold expectancy, signals dropped, UNKNOWN count) whatever the outcome.
method: Resimulation, not trade-list filtering. Entries are regenerated with RD-002's own config objects (rd2.families2.build_configs / rd2.families3.build_configs3) and the harness simulator (rd.fastsim.simulate_entries) with the entrant's declared exit spec. A gate drops candidate entries BEFORE simulation, so a stood-down entry frees its position slot exactly as a live stand-down would. ANCHOR REQUIREMENT: each ungated resimulation must reproduce the RD-002 published pooled OOS trades / expectancy / PF to within 1e-9 before any gated number from that entrant is reported; an anchor failure voids the run and is reported as such.
question: Can a causal market-regime detector improve the two live forward entrants by standing them down (suppressing entries) in hostile regimes, judged walk-forward / out-of-sample only, net of costs?
reporting: RESULTS_RD15.md + results_rd15/synthesis.json with one row per cell (8 gated + 2 anchor baselines), board entry via PR from fresh main. Coordinator merges; this crew does not merge.
research_only: The live entrants' parameters and behaviour do NOT change as a result of this study. Any gate that meets the improvement rule below is a CANDIDATE for the owner's decision plus forward-demo validation, never an adoption.
title: Market-regime gating of the two live forward entrants (ichimoku tk_cloud 4h, dow_effect reversal 1d)

trials.cells: 4 gates x 2 entrants; one cell = one trial in the global counter, whatever its outcome
trials.not_trials: the 2 ungated baseline reproductions (anchors) and any 2x-cost sensitivity re-runs
